reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-08: Unitas Accountable dashboard reserves_split snapshot (total reserves $55,511,787.70, supply $53,052,105.13, collateralization 104.64%) exposes four venue/instrument buckets. Curated slice names mirror the adapter reserves_split identities verbatim. Weights refreshed to the 2026-08-08 capture: Solana 47.57%, Bitcoin 35.17%, Binance 15.02%, BNB Smart Chain 2.24%. The Bitcoin bucket is new since the prior review and represents BTC/WBTC on-chain collateral per Unitas docs; the three venue buckets continue to aggregate undisclosed instrument-level composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable dashboard API reserves_split venue/instrument allocation captured 2026-08-08; per-venue instrument composition undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The venue split identifies where reserves are attested but not what each venue holds: Binance, Solana and BNB Smart Chain aggregate collateral assets, long/short notionals, hedge counterparties, margin, custody-provider shares, and insurance-fund balances per venue. Bitcoin/WBTC is identified as an asset class but its custody arrangement and hedge status are not itemized.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The Binance venue bucket aggregates off-exchange custodied collateral and hedge positions without disclosing current instrument-level composition.
The Solana venue bucket aggregates on-chain collateral and hedge positions without disclosing current instrument-level composition.
The BNB Smart Chain venue bucket aggregates on-chain collateral and hedge positions without disclosing current instrument-level composition.
Bitcoin/WBTC is an external cryptoasset held as collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
